exercises.name: 90/90 Hamstring Stretch
cues: On your back, thigh vertical; slowly straighten the knee.
Keep the other leg relaxed; pulse gently.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
cues: Sit tall with both knees at 90°; rotate the knees side to side.
Hands-free if you can, and lead with the hips.
exercises.desc: Seated with both legs bent at 90° (front leg and back leg), rotate the knees to switch sides without using your hands.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Ribs down, glutes tight; roll out until you're about to lose it.
Pull back with the abs, not the hips.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
cues: Big, slow circles; draw the biggest wheel you can.
Both directions; feel every degree of the ankle.

exercises.name: Volleyball Approach Jump
cues: Accelerate into the last two steps: left-right-left for righties.
Big arm swing, plant the heels, turn speed into height.
Long penultimate step, then a quick close. Swing both arms up hard.
exercises.desc: Your full spike approach and jump without a ball (or with a toss). Maximal intent every rep.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
cues: Start small and grow bigger, forward then back.
Relaxed shoulders, long arms.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
cues: Start palms in; rotate out as you press.
Smooth rotation, no jerking.

exercises.name: 45° Back Extension
cues: Hinge at the hips over the pad with a neutral spine.
Squeeze the glutes to rise; stop at a straight line, no over-arching.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Big breath into the brace, then sit straight down between your hips.
Screw your feet into the floor; knees chase your pinky toes.
Drive up chest-first so hips and shoulders rise together.

exercises.name: Backpedal to Sprint
cues: Quick backpedal with your chest over your toes.
Open the hips on the cue and sprint. React, don't think.
exercises.desc: Backpedal 5 m, then plant, open the hips and sprint forward 10 m, like chasing a shanked pass.

exercises.name: Backward Sled Drag
cues: Lean back and take short, fast steps. Knee-friendly quad burn.
Stay on the balls of the feet the whole way.

exercises.name: Backward Med-Ball Throw
cues: Squat, then explode, launching the ball overhead behind you.
Hips do the work; arms just steer.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
cues: Bridge up first, then curl the ball in without dropping the hips.
Slow on the way out; that's where hamstrings get armor.

exercises.name: Banded Speed Bench
cues: Light bar with bands; accelerate through the whole rep.
Fast down (controlled), faster up.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Arms straight; pull the band to the chest by squeezing the shoulder blades.
Slow return. The rear delts are the hitting arm's brakes.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
cues: Lean slightly forward; elbows stay at your sides.
Squeeze at lockout for one second.

exercises.name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Set the stance first; the front shin stays close to vertical.
Control the descent and stand up through the front foot.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
cues: Elbows pinned; curl without swinging the hips.
Squeeze at the top and lower in two seconds.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cues: Hinge to about 45°, brace, and row the bar to the lower ribs.
No hip-humping; the torso angle stays locked.

exercises.name: Barefoot Sand Walk
cues: Easy pace and nasal breathing; let the sand massage your feet.
Walk tall and swing the arms loose. This is moving meditation.
exercises.desc: An easy walk barefoot on soft sand. Strengthens feet and ankles while flushing the legs.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
cues: Athletic stance, fast alternating waves from the shoulders.
Breathe. Keep the waves all the way to the anchor.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
cues: Knees hover an inch off the ground; opposite hand and foot move together.
Keep the back flat enough to balance a cup of tea.
exercises.desc: On hands and feet with knees just off the ground, crawl forward with opposite hand and foot moving together.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
cues: Hands on the bench behind you; lower to 90°.
Shoulders stay down and back, away from the ears.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Shoulder blades pinned, feet driving; bar to the lower chest.
Bend the bar and push yourself away from it.
Touch soft, then drive explosively. Same groove every rep.

exercises.name: Easy Stationary Bike
cues: Zone 1 easy, enough to hold a conversation.
High cadence, low resistance; legs flush, mind clears.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
cues: Reach the opposite arm and leg long; hips stay level.
Pause and exhale. Balance a cup of tea on the low back.
exercises.desc: On hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg, pause, and return with control.

exercises.name: Block Jump
cues: Hands high and in front; quick dip, press over the net.
Land balanced and ready to move. No drifting.
exercises.desc: Stand at the net with hands at shoulder height, dip and jump straight up, pressing hands over the tape. Land in place.

exercises.name: Bottoms-Up Kettlebell Clean
cues: Crush the handle and clean the bell upside-down to the shoulder.
Balance it. The cuff lights up to keep it steady.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
cues: Inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4.
Shoulders heavy, jaw loose. Breath is the root of all bending.
exercises.desc: Seated or lying, breathe in a square: inhale for 4 seconds, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4.

exercises.name: Box Jump
cues: Arm swing, explode, land soft and quiet in a half squat.
Step down. Save the knees for jumping, not landing.

exercises.name: Box Squat
cues: Sit back to the box and stay tight; no plopping.
Pause with the brace on, then explode off the box.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
cues: Big arm swing; jump out, not up, and stick the landing.
Land in an athletic stance and hold for two seconds.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Most of the weight on the front foot; the back foot is a kickstand.
Drop the back knee straight down, drive up through the front heel.
Lean the torso slightly forward to load the glute.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
cues: Slight forward lean; hug a tree and cross the hands.
Big stretch, controlled squeeze.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
cues: Hips still; crunch the ribs toward the pelvis.
Round the spine; this isn't a hip hinge.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
cues: Step back for tension at the bottom; elbows still.
Squeeze and hold the top for one second.

exercises.name: Cable Hip Adduction
cues: Stand tall and sweep the leg across your body with control.
Slow return; don't let the cable yank you open.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Cable behind you for tension at the bottom; raise to shoulder height.
Slow negative and no shrug.

exercises.name: Cable Low-to-High Lift
cues: Low to high across the body, finishing tall.
Brace first, then rotate; control the return.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cues: Cross the cables and sweep back wide at shoulder height.
No shrugging; the neck stays long.

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch
cues: Back heel down, knee straight; lean into the wall.
Hold, then bend the knee slightly to find the soleus.

exercises.name: Carioca
cues: Quick hips; the back foot crosses behind with a high knee.
Stay light and rhythmic, arms relaxed.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
cues: Round up as you exhale, arch as you inhale.
Move one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: Weighted Chest Dip
cues: Lean forward slightly and lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows.
Press up and squeeze the chest; no shoulder shrug.

exercises.name: Med-Ball Chest Pass
cues: Step and throw from the chest as hard as you can.
Thumbs down on the follow-through; full arm extension.

exercises.name: Med-Ball Chest Push to Sprint
cues: Throw from a low athletic stance and chase it immediately.
Transfer push power into acceleration.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
cues: Chest stays on the pad; pull with the back, not momentum.
Full stretch at the bottom, hard squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
cues: Knees wide, hips to the heels, arms long.
Breathe into the back of the ribs.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
cues: Palms facing you; pull the chest to the bar.
Squeeze the biceps and lats together at the top.

exercises.name: Clean Pull
cues: Same path as the clean: patient off the floor, explosive at the hip.
Finish tall on the toes with a big shrug and long arms.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Hands just inside shoulder width; elbows tucked.
Touch the lower chest and drive with the triceps.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Pulldown
cues: Tall chest; pull the handle to the sternum.
Full stretch overhead between reps.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
cues: Hands under the shoulders, elbows brushing the ribs.
Triceps finish; full lockout each rep.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
cues: Fast dip, full arm swing, reach for the ceiling.
Treat each rep like a max attempt, then reset.

exercises.name: Cobra Pose
cues: Hips down, press the chest forward and up.
Shoulders away from the ears; gentle back bend.
exercises.desc: Lying face down, press through the hands to lift the chest while hips stay on the floor.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
cues: Elbow braced on the inner thigh; curl to the shoulder.
Supinate hard at the top.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
cues: Top leg on the bench, hips stacked, body in one straight line.
Squeeze the bench with your inner thigh; no sagging.
exercises.desc: Side plank with your top leg resting on a bench (knee or ankle) and the bottom leg free. Lifts the hips using the adductors. Elite groin insurance for lateral movers.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
cues: Sit deep into one heel; the straight leg's toes point up.
Shift side to side slowly while staying low.
exercises.desc: Wide stance. Shift your weight and squat deep over one leg while the other stays straight with toes pointing up, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
cues: Curl across the body toward the opposite shoulder.
Control the descent; no swinging.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
cues: Pull the arm across the chest below shoulder height.
Keep the shoulder blade down; gentle stretch.

exercises.name: Crossover Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back and across like a curtsy; front knee stays over the foot.
Feel the outer glute working to keep the pelvis level.

exercises.name: Cuban Press
cues: Upright row to 90°, rotate up, then press overhead.
Featherweight load; this is cuff and posture work.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Deep stretch at the bottom, press up and slightly in.
Wrists stacked over the elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise (Step)
cues: Heels sink below the step, then rise onto the big toe.
Three seconds down; the eccentric is where the armor forms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: The floor limits range, which is easy on the shoulder.
Pause at the bottom, press with a neutral wrist.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
cues: Open wide with soft elbows until you feel the stretch.
Bring them up like hugging a barrel.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Extension
cues: Both hands under the top plate; elbows close to the head.
Lower behind the head, extend fully.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Row the dumbbell to the hip pocket, not the armpit.
Square shoulders; let the lat stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
cues: Elbows slightly forward; press in a smooth arc.
Lower to ear level under control.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
cues: Low back pressed into the floor; extend opposite arm and leg.
Exhale fully on each rep.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Bar over mid-foot; pull the slack out before it leaves the floor.
Push the floor, then drive the hips through and squeeze at lockout.
Keep the bar dragging your legs the whole way up.

exercises.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back off the platform; knee kisses the floor.
Drive up through the front foot. Big range builds big glutes.

exercises.name: Depth Jump to Box
cues: Step off (don't jump off), touch, and rebound instantly.
Minimal ground time. The floor is lava.

exercises.name: Diagonal Bound
cues: Drive the knee forward and across; cover distance and height.
Land balanced and go again rhythmically.

exercises.name: Dowel Shoulder Pass-Through
cues: Wide grip; arc the stick overhead and behind with straight arms.
Narrow the grip a little each week.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
cues: Hips high, push the floor away; heels reach down.
Pedal the feet to wake up the calves.
exercises.desc: From hands and knees, lift the hips up and back into an inverted V.

exercises.name: Drag Curl
cues: Drag the bar up the torso as the elbows travel back.
Squeeze hard at the top; slow on the way down.

exercises.name: Depth Drop Push-Up
cues: Drop from the boxes, absorb, and explode back up.
Minimal ground time; stay stiff through the trunk.

exercises.name: Easy Swim
cues: Long, relaxed strokes; easy enough to smile.
Mix in backstroke to open the chest and shoulders.
exercises.desc: Continuous easy swimming. Light, conversational effort that flushes the shoulders and legs.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
cues: Elbow at your side; rotate out against the band.
Keep the shoulder blade set down and back.

exercises.name: Cable External Rotation
cues: Towel under the elbow and rotate out without the elbow drifting.
Two seconds out, three seconds back.

exercises.name: Side-Lying External Rotation
cues: Elbow pinned to the side at 90°; rotate the forearm up.
Slow both ways. If you need momentum, it's too heavy.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
cues: Wrist-friendly grip; full range every rep.
Don't let the elbows drift forward at the top.

exercises.name: Face Pull
cues: Pull to the eyebrows with elbows high and thumbs back.
Finish like a double-biceps pose: rotate the hands back.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
cues: Tall posture, shoulders packed, short quick steps.
Crush the handles; grip is shoulder health.

exercises.name: Fast Skips
cues: Low, quick skips that minimize air time.
Punch the arms and stay on the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
cues: Feet on the bench, body straight; chest toward the floor.
Upper-chest builder. Slow down, fast up.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Stretch
cues: Ankle over the knee; draw the legs toward you.
Relax the jaw. Glutes release when you do.

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Press
cues: Triceps touch the floor softly; pause, then press.
No bounce. Pure lockout strength.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Adductors
cues: Face down, inner thigh on the roller; roll hip to knee.
Pause and breathe on the knots.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Calves
cues: Stack the legs; rotate to find the inner and outer calf.
Sand athletes' calves work overtime. Be generous here.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Glutes & Piriformis
cues: Sit on the roller, cross the ankle over the knee, lean into that hip.
Small circles on the tender spots.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Hamstrings
cues: Cross one leg over the other for more pressure.
Breathe out on the tender spots and let them melt.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Outer Thigh (IT Band)
cues: Support with the top leg; roll from hip to just above the knee.
Go gently. Spend more time on the glute and TFL above it.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Lats
cues: On your side, arm overhead; roll the armpit to mid-ribs.
Rotate slightly forward and back to find the fibers.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Outer Calf (Peroneals)
cues: Turn onto the outside of the lower leg and roll slowly.
Sand ankles say thank you.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Quads
cues: Slow passes, about an inch per second; pause on tender spots.
Bend the knee on the sticky spots to dig deeper.

exercises.name: Shin Rolling (Massage Stick)
cues: Seated, knee bent; roll the stick slowly up and down the front of the shin.
Light pressure; the tibialis just needs a reset.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Upper Back
cues: Hug yourself to spread the shoulder blades; roll mid to upper back.
Pause and extend over the roller to open the thoracic spine.

exercises.name: Foot Rolling (Ball)
cues: Roll the arch slowly from heel to toes.
Pause and press into tender spots for 10 breaths.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Forearms
cues: Roll the forearm and upper arm on the roller.
Pass-and-set forearms deserve love too.

exercises.name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
cues: Fingers point toward the knees; lean back gently.
Hitting arms and passing platforms need this.

exercises.name: Front Squat
cues: Elbows high, bar on the shelf; fingertips only hold it.
Sit tall and deep; your torso stays vertical like a stone pillar.
Knees forward, drive up through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
cues: Knees just behind the pad; curl up with the hamstrings, not the back.
Squeeze the glutes the whole time to keep the hips extended.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom; pry the hips open.
Bell tight to the chest, heels heavy, chest proud.

exercises.name: Good Morning
cues: Hinge back with soft knees until your torso nears parallel.
Stay braced; reverse by driving the hips forward.

exercises.name: Butterfly Groin Stretch
cues: Soles together; fold forward with a long spine.
Elbows gently press the knees toward the floor.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
cues: Feet mid-platform; let the knees travel forward fully.
Three seconds down, drive up without slamming the lockout.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
cues: Neutral grip; curl like you're lifting a hammer.
Builds the brachialis and forearm, an elbow's armor.

exercises.name: Hang Clean
cues: Hinge to mid-thigh, then jump and shrug.
Whip the elbows around fast; meet the bar, don't chase it.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch
cues: Lats on, bar close; jump the bar off the hip.
Fast turnover; punch the ceiling.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: No swinging; curl the pelvis up toward the bar.
Lower slowly. The eccentric builds the abs.

exercises.name: Happy Baby
cues: Hold the outside of the feet, knees toward the armpits.
Rock gently; tailbone stays heavy.
exercises.desc: On your back, hold the feet with the knees bent wide toward the armpits.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Curl
cues: Arms out at shoulder height; curl the handles toward your ears.
Keep the upper arms still and level.

exercises.name: Kneeling High-Pulley Row
cues: Pull to the upper chest with elbows wide and high.
Finish with the shoulder blades set down and back.

exercises.name: Quadruped Hip Circles
cues: On all fours, draw the biggest circle you can with your knee.
Keep the spine still; only the hip moves.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Chin tucked, ribs down; finish with the glutes, not the low back.
Shins vertical at the top; pause one second and squeeze.

exercises.name: Hurdle Hops
cues: Knees up fast; spend as little time on the ground as possible.
Stay tall and rhythmic between hurdles.

exercises.name: Inchworm
cues: Walk the hands out to a plank, then the feet to the hands.
Keep the legs as straight as you can.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Low incline (about 30°); bar to the upper chest.
Elbows about 45° from the torso; press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Incline Cable Fly
cues: Arms open wide, chest up, slight elbow bend.
Squeeze the hands together over the upper chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Arms hang behind you; curl from the full stretch.
Keep the shoulders back against the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Low incline; let the dumbbells sink to a full stretch.
Press up and together without clanging.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Chest on the incline; row and pause with the shoulder blades squeezed.
Lead with the elbows and keep the neck long.

exercises.name: Incline Reverse Fly + External Rotation
cues: Fly out, then rotate the forearms up at the top.
Light weight, perfect positions. This protects the serve.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
cues: Moderate incline, easy pace; no holding the rails.
Nasal breathing only. That's the speed limit.

exercises.name: Band Internal Rotation
cues: Elbow at your side; rotate in with control.
Balance the cuff. Both directions matter for a hitter.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
cues: Body in a plank; pull the chest to the bar.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: JM Press
cues: Half skull crusher, half close-grip press; bar lowers toward the chin.
Elbows stay forward; press back up powerfully.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
cues: Quiet, quick contacts on the balls of the feet.
Wrists turn the rope; elbows stay close.

exercises.name: Barbell Jump Squat
cues: Light load (20-30% of your squat); every rep is max height.
Quick dip, explode, land soft and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo
cues: Circle the bell tight around your head, both directions.
Ribs down; move the shoulders, not the lower back.
exercises.desc: Hold a light kettlebell upside-down by the horns and circle it slowly around your head, keeping it close.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Plyo Push-Up
cues: Push off the bell, switch hands in the air, land soft.
Fast and controlled with a tight plank.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Push Press
cues: Quick dip and drive; punch the bell to lockout.
Wrist straight, bicep by the ear at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Snatch
cues: Hike, snap the hips, punch through as the bell floats.
Don't let the bell flop onto your wrist.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hike it back, then snap the hips; the arm is just a rope.
Plank at the top: glutes tight, ribs down, bell floats.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
cues: Bell locked overhead, eyes on it; hinge sideways.
Push the hips out and keep the top arm vertical.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback
cues: Upper arm parallel to the floor; extend fully.
Squeeze at the top for one second.

exercises.name: Supine Twist
cues: Knee across the body, shoulders flat; look away.
Let gravity do it; exhale deeper each breath.

exercises.name: Knee Circles
cues: Feet together, hands on the knees; slow circles.
Gentle warm-up for knees that jump all day.

exercises.name: Kneeling Med-Ball Chest Push
cues: From tall kneeling, launch the ball out and fall into a push-up.
The hips fire first, then the arms punch.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Tuck the pelvis and squeeze the back glute, then shift forward.
Reach the arm overhead to add the lats.

exercises.name: Kneeling Jump to Squat
cues: Sit back to your heels, then snap the hips to land in a squat.
Pure hip power: stick the landing with flat feet.

exercises.name: Landmine Push Press
cues: Dip and drive the bar up with the legs.
Explode and lock out, then control back down.

exercises.name: Landmine 180
cues: Arms long; arc the bar hip to hip with a pivot.
Rotate through the hips, not just the arms.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
cues: Pull the bar to the upper chest; lead with the elbows.
Lean back slightly and feel the lats stretch at the top.

exercises.name: Wall Lat Stretch
cues: Forearm on the wall; lean in and sink the chest.
Feel the stretch from armpit to hip.

exercises.name: Lateral Bound
cues: Push off the outside leg and land on the other; stick it one second.
Knee over toes on landing; absorb like a spring.

exercises.name: Lateral Broad Jump
cues: Load the outside hip and jump as far sideways as you can.
Stick it balanced; the block move starts here.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Lead with the elbows to shoulder height.
Slight forward lean; pour the water out at the top.

exercises.name: Lateral Shuffle
cues: Low hips, wide base; push off the trail leg.
Never cross your feet; eyes up like you're reading a hitter.
exercises.desc: Athletic stance, shuffle sideways without clicking the feet together. Stay low the whole way.

exercises.name: Lateral Split Squat
cues: Sit into one hip with the other leg long and chest up.
Push the floor sideways to return, just like a defensive step.

exercises.name: Lean-Away Lateral Raise
cues: Hold the bench and lean away for a longer range.
Raise smoothly and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
cues: Slow and smooth; this is tendon work for jumper's knee prevention.
Pause two seconds at lockout, lower in three.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
cues: Hold a post; swing front-to-back, then side-to-side.
Gradually bigger, stay tall and relaxed.
exercises.desc: Hold a support and swing one leg forward and back, then across the body and out to the side.

exercises.name: Legs Up the Wall
cues: Hips close to the wall, legs resting up; arms relaxed.
Slow nasal breathing; let the legs drain.
exercises.desc: Lie on your back with your legs resting vertically against a wall.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
cues: Sweep up from the hips to eye level.
Upper-chest focus; keep a soft bend in the elbows.

exercises.name: Low Lunge (Crescent)
cues: Back knee down; sink the hips forward and reach up.
Squeeze the back glute to deepen the hip-flexor stretch.
exercises.desc: Kneeling lunge with arms overhead. Sink the hips forward to open the front of the back hip.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Lunge Pass-Through
cues: Pass the bell under the front leg each rep while staying upright.
Control the depth; the back knee hovers.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Hips pressed into the pad; curl fast, lower in three seconds.
Pull the toes up toward the shins to bias the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Landmine Single-Arm Row
cues: Staggered stance, hinge; row the bar end to the hip.
Big stretch at the bottom, no torso twist.

exercises.name: Med-Ball Overhead Slam
cues: Reach tall onto the toes, then slam through the core.
Throw it through the floor; hinge, catch, repeat.

exercises.name: Banded Monster Walk
cues: Stay low and wide; knees out against the band.
Small steps with constant tension.

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
cues: Don't re-bend the knees; pull high and turn the bar over.
A shoulder-strength drill for a powerful arm swing.

exercises.name: Side Neck Stretch
cues: Ear toward the shoulder; let the opposite shoulder sink.
Breathe slowly, no pulling.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press
cues: Palms facing each other is the shoulder-friendly pressing path.
Tuck the elbows and press smoothly.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Incline Press
cues: Palms in, elbows tucked; easy on the shoulders, hard on the chest.
Three seconds down, drive up.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
cues: Neutral grip is shoulder-friendly; pull the sternum to the handles.
Ribs down, no kipping, smooth tempo.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
cues: Hips locked straight; lower as slowly as you can.
Catch with your hands, push back up lightly, repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Overhead Press
cues: Glutes and abs tight; press the bar up and slightly back.
Head through the window at the top; full lockout.
Bar starts on the front delts, forearms vertical.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Med-Ball Slam
cues: Reach tall like an attack, then whip down through the core.
Alternate arms; the off-arm matters too.

exercises.name: Open Book Rotation
cues: Side-lying, knees stacked; open the top arm like a book.
Follow the hand with your eyes; exhale as you open.
exercises.desc: Lie on your side with the knees bent and stacked. Rotate the top arm open across the body to the floor behind you.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Extension
cues: Elbows point forward; reach the rope overhead.
Long-head stretch at the bottom is the money.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
cues: Snatch grip, press up into the bar, armpits facing forward.
Sit down slowly and stay balanced over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Overhead Med-Ball Throw
cues: Reach the ball deep behind your head and throw with the whole body.
Feels like a spike. Lead with the core and follow through.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
cues: Press straight out and resist the rotation.
Ribs down, glutes on, breathe behind the brace.

exercises.name: Pallof Press with Rotation
cues: Press out, rotate away under control, return to center.
Hips face forward; the torso does the rotating.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
cues: Shoulders back; close the handles with the chest.
Pause at full contraction.

exercises.name: Stick Chest & Shoulder Stretch
cues: Wide grip on a stick, then lift it slowly up and back behind your head.
Stop where the chest opens; breathe into the front of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt into Bridge
cues: Tilt the pelvis, then peel the spine up one segment at a time.
Lower the same way, one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
cues: Front shin angled forward, back leg long; square the hips.
Fold forward slowly and breathe into the outer hip.
exercises.desc: From all fours, bring one knee forward behind the wrist and extend the other leg back. Fold over the front shin.

exercises.name: Pin Press
cues: Bar starts on pins an inch off the chest; dead stop.
Drive explosively off the pins.

exercises.name: Plank
cues: Squeeze the glutes and quads; push the floor away.
Breathe. Shaking is just the body learning.

exercises.name: Plyo Push-Up
cues: Explode so the hands leave the floor; land soft and rebound.
Rigid plank. Power from the chest, not a hip flop.

exercises.name: Pogo Hops
cues: Stiff ankles; bounce like the ground is hot.
Minimal knee bend; let the Achilles do the work.
exercises.desc: Small, rapid two-footed hops with nearly straight knees. Bounce off the balls of the feet with minimal ground contact.

exercises.name: Power Clean
cues: Push the floor through the first pull and keep the bar close.
Violent hip extension, then pull yourself under with fast elbows.
Catch high with soft knees and elbows up.

exercises.name: Power Clean from Blocks
cues: Set tight on the blocks; no slack, no hitching.
Explode from a dead start and catch crisp.

exercises.name: Power Jerk
cues: Dip and drive, then punch yourself under in a quarter squat.
Lockout and stabilize before you stand.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
cues: Wide grip; brush the hip, then punch up and under.
Lock the elbows in the catch with soft knees and chest up.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
cues: Armpits on the pad; don't bounce out of the bottom.
Slow down the last third of each rep.

exercises.name: Prone Scorpion
cues: Face down, arms out; swing the heel across toward the opposite hand.
Gentle and controlled. Wake up the hips and T-spine.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
cues: Pack the shoulders, then drive the elbows to the back pockets.
Full hang at the bottom every rep; no half-reps.

exercises.name: Push Press
cues: Short, vertical dip, then drive the bar with the legs.
Punch the bar to lockout as the legs finish.

exercises.name: Push-Up
cues: Plank body; chest to the floor, elbows at 45°.
Push the floor away and spread the shoulder blades at the top.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
cues: Bar just below the knee; push the hips through to lockout.
Shoulders back at the top; don't hyperextend.

exercises.name: Seated Rear Delt Raise
cues: Chest on the thighs; raise the dumbbells out wide.
Pinkies up and squeeze the back of the shoulders.

exercises.name: Renegade Row
cues: Wide feet, plank tight; row without letting the hips rotate.
Opposite hand pushes the floor away.

exercises.name: Reverse Barbell Curl
cues: Overhand grip; elbows pinned, wrists neutral.
Lower slowly. Your forearms will file a complaint.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Reverse Fly
cues: Chest on the incline, soft elbows; open the arms like wings.
Lead with the pinkies and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Row
cues: Underhand grip; row to the belly button with elbows tight.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
cues: Swing the legs up with the glutes, not momentum.
Let the spine decompress on the way down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back long and lower the back knee softly.
Push through the front foot to return; stay tall.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
cues: Chest on the pad; sweep the handles back with straight arms.
Pause and squeeze the rear delts, then control the return.

exercises.name: Suspension Row
cues: Plank body, pull the hands to the ribs, thumbs rotate out.
Walk the feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soft knees; push the hips back until the hamstrings bite.
Bar drags the thighs, back flat, then snap the hips through.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
cues: Pin the elbows and pull the rope ends apart at the top.
Constant tension, slow eccentric.

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned; split the rope at the bottom.
Full lockout, then slow return.

exercises.name: Rotational Med-Ball Pass
cues: Rotate from the hips first, then the shoulders.
Stay tall and athletic; catch and reload fast.

exercises.name: Easy Row (Erg)
cues: Legs, hips, then arms. Smooth, relaxed strokes.
Breathe and let your heart rate rise gradually.

exercises.name: Runner's Stretch
cues: Staggered stance, hands beside the front foot, front heel flat.
Push the hips up and back; feel the front hamstring and back calf.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
cues: Lean back, chest proud; rotate the ribs, not just the arms.
Touch beside each hip with control.

exercises.name: Sand Footwork Flow
cues: Light shuffles, crossovers and skips at walking intensity.
Quiet feet, loose arms. Practice, not punishment.
exercises.desc: Low-intensity volleyball footwork patterns on sand: shuffles, crossover steps, drop steps and skips.

exercises.name: Easy Sand Jog
cues: Easy pace, short strides, let the feet wake up.
Breathe through the nose. If you can't chat, slow down.
exercises.desc: An easy jog on the sand to raise temperature and wake up feet and ankles.

exercises.name: Sand Sprint
cues: Drive the knees and punch the arms; sand rewards power.
Short, quick steps for the first five meters.
exercises.desc: Sprint on soft sand. Walk back for recovery. The sand cuts impact and doubles the effort.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
cues: Straight arms; pull the shoulder blades down and back.
Pause one second. This wakes up the lower traps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Scaption
cues: Thumbs up and raise in a Y, about 30° in front of you.
Stop at shoulder height; smooth and controlled.

exercises.name: Med-Ball Scoop Toss
cues: Load the hips low and throw the ball up and back with a full extension.
Jump with it; triple extension is the goal.

exercises.name: Lying Barbell Row
cues: Chest pinned to the bench; there's no cheating here.
Pull the bar to the bench and pause one second.

exercises.name: Seated Box Jump
cues: Sit on a bench, feet planted, explode straight onto the box.
Pure concentric power with no countermovement.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall and pull the handle to the belly; elbows skim the ribs.
Reach forward and let the shoulder blades spread before each rep.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: This hits the soleus, your sand-running engine.
Pause two seconds in the stretch; no bouncing.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
cues: Hinge from the hips and reach for the toes.
Soft knees are fine; chase length, not pain.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
cues: Lean forward slightly for a deeper hamstring stretch.
Squeeze hard at the bottom, control on the way up.

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Press
cues: Back tall against the pad; press straight up.
Lower to the chin with control.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Twist
cues: Cross a leg, sit tall, then rotate toward the bent knee.
Lengthen on the inhale, twist on the exhale.

exercises.name: Incline Serratus Shoulder Raise
cues: Arms locked; punch the dumbbells up using only the shoulder blades.
Feel the serratus wrap the ribs. A healthy scapula makes a healthy shoulder.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Straight up to the ears; pause one second.
No rolling. Up and down only.

exercises.name: Side Hop to Sprint
cues: Quick lateral hops, then explode into a sprint off the last one.
React. The transition is the whole drill.

exercises.name: Side Plank
cues: Elbow under the shoulder, hips high, body in one line.
Push the floor away and breathe behind the brace.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
cues: Pull the heel to the glute and push the hip forward.
Knees stay together.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Extension
cues: One arm at a time; lock out and squeeze.
Keep the elbow fixed by your side.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
cues: Row with a little rotation, like drawing back for a swing.
Hips square; let the shoulder reach forward at full stretch.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dead Hang
cues: Hang long and let the shoulder decompress.
Breathe slowly; switch hands before the grip fails.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Landmine Press
cues: The arcing path is the shoulder-friendly press for overhead athletes.
Reach through at the top and let the shoulder blade glide.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
cues: Pull the elbow to the hip with a slight torso crunch.
Let the shoulder blade rise fully at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Box Squat
cues: Sit back to the box on one leg, slow and controlled.
Knee over toes; stand without pushing off the free foot.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Drive through the heel and keep the hips level like a tabletop.
Pause at the top and feel the glute, not the hamstring.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Forward Hop
cues: Hop and land on the same leg; quiet, stable landings.
Drive the free knee to help the takeoff.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lateral Hop
cues: Hop side to side over a line on one leg.
Stiff ankle, level hips, eyes up.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Box Push-Off
cues: Drive through the foot on the box and get tall.
Land on the same foot and go again; knee drive like takeoff.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL (Kettlebell)
cues: Hips square to the floor; reach the free heel back.
Soft standing knee; hinge until the hamstring bites, then stand tall.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
cues: Lower to the forehead or just behind; elbows still.
Extend powerfully; don't let the elbows flare.

exercises.name: Sled Push
cues: Arms long, body at 45°, drive the knees.
Short, powerful steps through the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Sledgehammer Tire Strikes
cues: Slide the top hand down as the hammer falls; switch sides.
Power comes from the hips and core like an attack swing.

exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
cues: Lying on the shoulder, gently press the forearm toward the floor.
Mild stretch only. The hitting arm needs internal rotation back.
exercises.desc: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front at 90°. Gently press the forearm down to stretch the back of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
cues: Wide grip, hips lower than a normal pull, chest up.
Keep the bar close and push patiently through the floor.

exercises.name: Soleus & Achilles Stretch
cues: Bent knee, heel down; sink the knee over the toes.
Long, slow breaths. Achilles health equals jump health.

exercises.name: Spanish Squat (Band Isometric)
cues: Band behind the knees; sit back with shins vertical.
Hold the burn and breathe; this is patellar-tendon armor.
exercises.desc: Loop a heavy band around a rack behind your knees, lean back into it and sit to a half squat with vertical shins. Hold.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
cues: Chest on the incline, arms hanging straight down.
Curl and squeeze hard; no shoulder swing.

exercises.name: Split Jerk
cues: Dip and drive straight up, then split fast under the bar.
Front shin vertical, back knee soft; recover front foot first.

exercises.name: Split Jump
cues: From a lunge, jump high and switch legs in the air.
Land soft with the front knee over the foot.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Full stretch at the bottom, pause, then rise as high as possible.
Knees straight; drive through the big toe.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Press
cues: Squeeze the glutes; press without leaning back.
Stack the wrists over the elbows.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circles
cues: Hands on the hips; make slow, big circles.
Both directions; loosen the hips before you load them.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cues: Whole foot on the box; drive through it with no push from the back leg.
Stand fully tall at the top, then step down slowly.

exercises.name: Step-Up with Knee Drive
cues: Drive the free knee up like your approach takeoff.
Finish tall on the box leg with hip, knee and ankle fully extended.

exercises.name: Straddle Stretch
cues: Legs wide, toes up; walk the hands forward.
Long spine first, then fold.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cues: Arms long, sweep the bar to the thighs with the lats.
Ribs down; don't let the low back arch.

exercises.name: Suitcase Deadlift
cues: One weight at your side; don't let the torso tilt.
Hinge and stand like the weight isn't there.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
cues: Lift the arms and legs a few inches and squeeze the glutes.
Long neck; reach out, not up.

exercises.name: Supine Med-Ball Chest Throw
cues: From your back, punch the ball straight up as high as possible.
Catch, absorb, and throw again immediately.

exercises.name: Supine Single-Arm Overhead Throw
cues: Arm fully back; sit up and throw like a quick attack.
Light ball, fast arm. Speed is the goal.

exercises.name: Svend Press
cues: Squeeze the plates together and press straight out.
Keep crushing the plates the whole time.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
cues: Chest proud, hinge locked; drive the elbows back.
Pause at the chest and lower under control.

exercises.name: Tate Press
cues: Elbows flare out; lower the dumbbells to the chest.
Extend up; pure triceps.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
cues: From all fours, slide one arm under the body and rest the shoulder down.
Then reach to the sky. The T-spine loves rotation.
exercises.desc: On hands and knees, thread one arm under the opposite arm, rotating the upper back, then open to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
cues: Back against the wall, heels forward; pull the toes to the shins.
Pause at the top and lower slowly. Shins are an ankle's best friend.
exercises.desc: Lean your back on a wall with heels about a foot out. Keep the legs straight and raise the toes toward the shins, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cues: Push the floor away and let hips and knees open together.
Lats tight, chest up, stand up fast.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Jump
cues: Light load (20-40% of your trap bar max); jump as high as possible.
Land soft, reset and breathe before every rep.
exercises.desc: Hold a lightly loaded trap bar, dip and jump straight up, then land softly in an athletic stance.

exercises.name: Triangle Pose
cues: Long legs; hinge sideways and reach the top arm to the sky.
Stack the shoulders and breathe into the side body.
exercises.desc: Straight-legged wide stance, hinge sideways over the front leg with arms in one vertical line.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
cues: Reach down the back, other hand gently pushes the elbow.
Stay tall; don't crunch the neck.

exercises.name: Tuck Jump
cues: Pull the knees to the chest at the top of each jump.
Land on the balls of the feet and rebound immediately.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
cues: Eyes on the bell; arm vertical at every stage.
Slow is smooth. Earn every position.

exercises.name: Underhand Pulldown
cues: Supinated grip, elbows tight to the body.
Pull to the upper chest and squeeze for one second.

exercises.name: Upper Back Stretch
cues: Clasp the hands in front and round the upper back.
Push the hands away to spread the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: V-Bar Pulldown
cues: Drive the elbows down and in; squeeze the lats.
Control the bar back up for three seconds.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
cues: Long stride, back knee hovers, torso tall.
On sand, punch each step into the ground; it fights back.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
cues: Back and forearms on the wall; slide up while keeping contact.
Ribs down; feel the lower traps and serratus.
exercises.desc: Stand with your back to a wall, arms in a goalpost position, and slide the arms overhead while keeping contact.

exercises.name: Warrior II
cues: Front knee over the ankle, arms long, gaze past the front hand.
Sink and hold. The legs burn, the mind stays calm.
exercises.desc: Wide stance with the front knee bent and arms extended to the sides.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
cues: Start from a dead hang and pull the elbows down to the ribs.
Chest to the bar; control the descent in two seconds.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
cues: High to low across the body; pivot the back foot.
Arms stay long, rotation comes from hips and torso.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
cues: Lunge, elbow to instep, then rotate the arm to the sky.
Breathe into each position; don't rush the rotation.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
cues: Interlace the fingers and roll the wrists both ways.
Your passing platform will thank you.

exercises.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
cues: Forearms on the bench, let the bar roll to the fingertips.
Curl the wrist up and squeeze.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
cues: Arms out front; roll the weight up and slowly back down.
Forearms built for a thousand passes.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
cues: Curl palms-up, rotate at the top, lower palms-down slowly.
Forearm and elbow insurance for the hitting arm.
